title: Tool Cache
description: The observation cache. Keyed by tool + args digest; validated by content hashes of the inputs the tool observed. Invalidation is by content hash only, never by time: a file unchanged for a year is a valid hit, a file changed one second ago is a miss. A hit is served with zero model involvement and zero tool re-execution. Lives in the harness state dir (gitignored). Savings fields exist so efficiency is measured, not assumed.

entries.description: Keys are '{tool}:{args_digest}' where args_digest = sha256 of the canonical JSON of the tool's arguments.

args_preview.description: Human-readable hint of the args (e.g. the file path) for debugging; the digest, not this, is authoritative.

inputs.description: Map of observed input path -> sha256 of its content at cache time. A hit requires EVERY listed input to hash-match now. Tools observing non-file inputs record a synthetic key (e.g. 'env:PATH') with a hash of that value.

output.description: Inline cached output. Use for small outputs; use output_ref for large ones so the cache index stays cheap to load.

output_ref.description: Path (relative to the state dir) of a blob file holding the cached output. Exactly one of output / output_ref should be present.

token_estimate.description: Estimated tokens of the output; each hit adds this to tokens_saved_total.

stats.description: Rolled-up counters for the eval layer.
